questions.name: wait_for
questions.question: Is asyncio.wait_for a strict total wall-clock deadline, and what happens to the awaited task on timeout?
semantic_facts: It cancels the task and raises TimeoutError.
It waits for cancellation to finish, so total time can exceed the timeout.
questions.citation_requirement: Every claim needs exact entailing frozen spans.

questions.name: shield
questions.question: When a caller awaiting shield(task) is cancelled, what happens to the inner task and caller, and why keep a strong reference to the task?
semantic_facts: Caller still receives CancelledError while shield protects inner task from that caller cancellation.
Loop holds weak references; otherwise an unreferenced task can be collected before completion.
